profile.Name: Harmothoe
profile.Personality: A former slave of the Holy Nation, bitter toward men and hostile to Skeletons, with a sword she calls Nail. She admires Moll above the Phoenix.
profile.Backstory: Trader. Once enslaved by Holy Nation soldiers, she now trades in Heng and Trader's Edge.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls men 'meatbags' and 'gorillos', women 'sister'; threatens to castrate attackers; 'Life is tough, but so am I'.
